data.one_liner: A Flutter widget that draws hexagon shapes and supports flat or pointy orientations.
data.what_it_does: Provides a HexagonWidget for single hexagons and two grid widgets (HexagonOffsetGrid and HexagonGrid) that arrange tiles in hexagonal layouts. It supports custom colors, padding, elevation, and child widgets.
use_when: You need a hexagonal tile or grid in a UI
You want to display data in a hexagonal grid without custom drawing code
You need simple flat or pointy hexagon shapes for buttons or cards
avoid_when: You require advanced performance tuning for very large grids
You need a fully custom hexagon path with animations beyond elevation
strengths: Supports both flat and pointy hexagons
Built-in offset and cube/axial grid layouts
weaknesses: Limited to static hexagon shapes, no animation support
Grid performance not benchmarked for very large numbers
No theming or style system beyond basic color
data.setup_notes: Add dependency in pubspec and import 'package:hexagon/hexagon.dart';
